messages:
Sam (DevRel): Idea: 30m community mini-lab next Thurs to ship a tiny OSS refapp + quick benchmark. Keep it low-friction: clone, env, run.
Priya (Content): On it. I'll draft a short "how-we-built" post + 4 social captions, tone = pragmatic + numbers.
Noah (Bench): Recommend 3 configs: hosted-small, hosted-medium, local-quant. Run 50 samples each. Capture p50/p95/p99 + $/1k tokens.
Tess (Growth): I'll make the form and routing: Google Form -> HubSpot list "mini-lab-apr-2026" -> Segment -> Salesforce. Capture role & deployment preference + GDPR consent.
Marco (OSS): I'll add examples/mini-lab, CONTRIBUTING.md, and a tiny Dockerfile. Add a "Run in 5 mins" badge.
Sam (DevRel): Keep demo to <=5 commands and include "try hosted" button. Also short video 15s.
Priya (Content): Draft outline: why (30s), setup (2m), build (10m), bench (5m), next steps, contrib CTA. I'll have draft by Wed.
Noah (Bench): Bench snippet: seq 1 50 | xargs -P8 curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi","max_tokens":64}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate. Will upload bench.csv.
Tess (Growth): RSVP fields: name, email, org, role, deployment, tz, utm_source. Webhook to Segment for analytics.
release-bot: New branch created: refs/heads/mini-lab-apr-2026 by Marco (OSS). CI checks queued.
Marco (OSS): Pushing initial commit with Dockerfile and GH Action for examples lint.
Sam (DevRel): Rehearsal day-before, 30m. Prefer Wed 10am PT.
Priya (Content): Wed 10am PT works.
Noah (Bench): I'll share final CSVs and chart before rehearsal.
Tess (Growth): I'll prepare email reminders (24h, 1h) and a follow-up with repo link.
Sam (DevRel): Owners: Marco=repo/CI, Priya=content/assets, Noah=bench, Tess=rsvp/routing, Sam=host. Aim to ship by Friday EOD. :rocket:
